mechanism_narrative: An increase in the Consumer Price Index (CPIAUCSL) above 2% YoY signals inflationary pressure, leading to tighter monetary policy expectations and negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: If CPIAUCSL YoY > 2% and 20-day forward returns are positive in > 60% of instances, or if Rank IC < 0.05 over any 3-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: A sharp rise in unemployment rate (UNRATE) by more than 0.5% in a month signals economic weakness, leading to negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 5 trading days.
failure_condition: If UNRATE rises > 0.5% in a month and 5-day forward returns are positive in > 60% of instances, or if Rank IC < 0.03 over any 2-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: A significant drop in retail sales (RSAFS) by more than 2% month-over-month signals weakening consumer demand, leading to negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: If RSAFS drops > 2% MoM and 20-day forward returns are positive in > 60% of instances, or if Rank IC < 0.05 over any 3-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: An increase in industrial production (INDPRO) by more than 1% month-over-month signals strengthening supply-side fundamentals, leading to positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: If INDPRO rises > 1% MoM and 60-day forward returns are negative in > 40% of instances, or if Rank IC < 0.03 over any 3-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: A sustained decrease in the federal funds rate (FEDFUNDS) over 3 months signals an accommodative monetary policy, leading to positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: If FEDFUNDS decreases over 3 months and 20-day forward returns are negative in > 40% of instances, or if Rank IC < 0.03 over any 2-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: When unemployment rate (UNRATE) is below 4% and payroll employment (PAYEMS) increases by more than 200,000, it signals a tight labor market and strong economic growth, leading to positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: If UNRATE < 4% and PAYEMS increases > 200,000 and 20-day forward returns are negative in > 40% of instances, or if Rank IC < 0.05 over any 3-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: When housing starts (HOUST) increase by more than 5% month-over-month and retail sales (RSAFS) increase by more than 1% month-over-month, it signals strong consumer demand, leading to positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 60 trading days.
candidate_trigger: HOUST rises > 5% MoM and RSAFS rises > 1% MoM
failure_condition: If HOUST rises > 5% MoM and RSAFS rises > 1% MoM and 60-day forward returns are negative in > 40% of instances, or if Rank IC < 0.05 over any 3-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: During a late-cycle expansion, when industrial production (INDPRO) is above its 12-month moving average and GDP (GDPC1) growth is positive, it signals robust economic activity, leading to positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: If INDPRO > 12-month MA and GDPC1 growth > 0% and 60-day forward returns are negative in > 40% of instances, or if Rank IC < 0.05 over any 3-year rolling window.
